summary: Iteration 2 testing of KHATTA-MEETHA dual-role refresh. Backend: 13/13 new pytest cases pass (dual-roles on register/login/set-role, owner-cannot-book-own, notifications on book/approve/message, unread-count + mark-read + read-all, typing indicator round-trip, conversations.unread_count, geo reverse/search, property views tracking). Frontend: landing renders in new clean Inter/white/indigo design; login as owner@test.com lands on /dashboard; role switcher (Tenant view / Owner view) visible with data-testid=role-switcher; notification bell shows red count badge (3); /notifications page renders all items with correct types (appointment_request, message); /dashboard/list-property loads Leaflet map + searchable address; explore->property detail renders with Book a visit form for non-owned property. Theme toggle button present in navbar.

minor.issue: Bare try/except swallows ALL exceptions and returns empty dict/list with HTTP 200. Caller cannot distinguish 'no results' from 'upstream Nominatim down'. Consider returning 502 or logging.
TTL index created with expireAfterSeconds=10, but get_typing uses 6s cutoff. Slight inconsistency (works fine, just noted).
View tracking swallowed in bare except - if get_current_user throws non-auth errors (e.g. DB hiccup) we silently lose data. Use except HTTPException: pass.
Always merges role into roles array, but never lets user REMOVE a role. OK for dual-role MVP, just noted.

issues: STILL uses browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) and time input — same as iteration 1. Should be replaced with shadcn DatePicker/calendar for design consistency.

6 stat cards now (Properties, Available, Occupied, Pending visits, Active chats, Rent collected) — cleaner than iter1, but 'Rent collected ₹0' icon background tile is dark/black while other tiles are pastel — visual inconsistency.

action_items: Replace native datetime/time inputs in PropertyDetail booking form with shadcn DatePicker (carried over from iter1).
Normalize Rent collected stat card icon background to match other pastel tiles on the Owner Dashboard.
Tighten bare except blocks in /api/geo/* and /api/properties/{pid} view tracking — should catch specific exceptions and log.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~760 lines and mixes auth, properties, chat, notifications, geo, uploads, admin — should be split into routers per domain (auth, properties, chat, notifications, geo, admin).
create_notification is fire-and-forget DB insert that runs synchronously inside the request — fine for now but in high-traffic should move to a task queue.
Nominatim is called inline via blocking `requests` inside async endpoints (/api/geo/*) — will block event loop; switch to httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
get_current_user is called inside GET /properties/{pid} in a try/except (anonymous-allowed pattern). The bare `except: pass` will hide DB and JWT validation errors — narrow to HTTPException.
Owner-self-book is blocked server-side correctly (400), but messages endpoint does NOT block sending a message to yourself; frontend hides UI per the spec, but defense-in-depth check missing.
Notifications schema has no pagination cursor / no aging — list_notifs hard-caps at limit=50 but never trims old read notifications; will grow forever per user.
make_user_public exposes `roles` array which may include 'admin' — confirm this isn't leaked to other users via /api/conversations.other_user or /api/properties.owner (currently it would be).
test_credentials: admin@khattameetha.com/admin123, owner@test.com/owner123, tenant@test.com/tenant123 — all working with dual roles ['khatta','meetha'] (admin has all three).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend pytest files now: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iter1 baseline) and /app/backend/tests/iteration2_test.py (dual-role, notifs, typing, geo, owner-block, views). Run both with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend testids confirmed: role-switcher, switch-tenant, switch-owner, notif-bell, notif-count, login-email, login-password, login-submit. Theme toggle is the moon/sun icon button in navbar (next to bell). Property detail booking still uses native HTML datetime/time inputs — flag again if not fixed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. All review_request items verified working both via API tests and UI screenshots.
